summary: Frontend-only testing of Ahorramix in DEMO (preview URL) and REAL/WooCommerce mode (local Apache http://127.0.0.1:8096 proxying ahorramix.com /wp-json). All 9 scenarios from the review request pass. Logos visible on /, /tienda, /producto/..., /cuenta, /carrito at both 1440px and 390px. Config script loaded with ?t= timestamp. /index.html redirects to /. REAL mode shows the real WooCommerce product (Producto de prueba Ahorramix. 999,00 €) in /tienda, PDP, Más vendidos y Novedades; add-to-cart writes a cart item (image=/images/brand/sin-imagen.jpg), checkout-button href = http://127.0.0.1:8096/?ahorramix_cart=14%3A1 (not clicked, per instructions). No console/page errors.
critical_code_review_comments: Cart storage key is 'ahorramix_cart_v1' (not 'ahorramix_cart'). Only relevant for test scripts; no bug.
Add-to-cart button on PDP uses testid 'add-to-cart-button' (prefix='') — correct, but consider prefixing with 'pdp-' for easier differentiation from QuickView ('quick-view-add-to-cart-button').
Many Lenis 'non-static position' console warnings persist (noise only, carried over from iteration 1).
test_credentials: N/A - demo mode local login works; real WC product publicly listed via /wp-json
seed_data_creation: None. For every page load the test seeds localStorage ahorramix_cookie_choice=accepted and am_welcome_seen=1 to suppress banners/modals.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified: (1) window.AHORRAMIX_CONFIG.commerceMode === 'demo' on preview; === 'woocommerce' on 127.0.0.1:8096. (2) ahorramix-config.js is loaded with ?t=<Date.now()> in both envs (document.write cache-busting works). (3) GET /index.html → redirects to /. (4) data-testid=site-logo + footer-logo have naturalWidth=640 on all five pages at 1440px and 390px. (5) In REAL mode /tienda renders 1 product card, PDP /producto/producto-de-prueba-ahorramix loads, add-to-cart updates ahorramix_cart_v1, /carrito checkout-button href is http://127.0.0.1:8096/?ahorramix_cart=14%3A1 (NOT clicked). (6) Home 'Más vendidos' and 'Novedades' tabs show the real product (taggedOrLatest fallback working). (7) No pageerrors. Local Apache on 127.0.0.1:8096 is up and WC Store API proxy to ahorramix.com returns product id=14. Demo-mode login button testid is 'google-login-demo-button' (inside LoginDialog opened via account-login-link).
